_comment: The 3D view, built by cave-viewer (python -m caveviewer build caves.json --out site/): every survey in CheddarCatchment.th together, beneath the LiDAR ground, every entrance named. The Survex files Therion imports are built first with cavern. See cave-viewer's caveviewer/schema.json for every key.

caves.name: The Cheddar Catchment
caves.credit: the Cave Registry Data Archive's CheddarCatchment dataset, by UBSS, MCG and many other clubs and cavers, each cave under the terms in its own files

grid._comment: Therion's export is on the ST 100 km square of the National Grid
